spec.description: - If an integer, N, sum over the last N axes of `x1` and the first N axes of `x2` in order. The sizes of the corresponding axes must match. - Or, a list of axes to be summed over, first sequence applying to `x1`, second to `x2`. Both sequences must be of the same length.
constraints: If a list, both sequences must be of the same length

output.description: The tensor dot product of the inputs.

constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes
